MCENCHANTINGTABLE-CONFIG_TITLE.title: MC Enchanting Table
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-BOOK_REWARDS.title: Book Rewards
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-ACT1_NORMAL_COMBATS_PE: Sets the number of eligible normal combat victories required to trigger one book reward in Act 1.
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-ACT2_NORMAL_COMBATS_PE: Sets the number of eligible normal combat victories required to trigger one book reward in Act 2.
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-ACT3_NORMAL_COMBATS_PE: Sets the number of eligible normal combat victories required to trigger one book reward in Act 3.
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-NORMAL_COMBAT_BOOK_REW: Sets the number of books offered when the normal combat counter is completed.
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-ELITE_BOOK_REWARD_AMOU: Sets the number of books offered after an eligible elite victory. Set to 0 to disable elite book rewards.
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-BOSS_BOOK_REWARD_AMOUN: Sets the base number of books offered after a boss victory. Any end-of-act normal combat remainder reward is added separately.
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-V2.ThirdAndLaterOccurr: Same enchantment third and later appearance multiplier
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-V2.repeatWeightDescrip: Adjusts the chance for the same enchantment to appear repeatedly in one candidate group. Lower values make multiple copies of the same enchantment less likely.
MCENCHANTINGTABLE-V2.resetBody: This restores all MC Enchanting Table custom parameters to their defaults.
